On free-weight exercises, a spotter can help lift a supramaximal load after the trainee lowers it under control. A flywheel device provides an appealing option for inducing eccentric overload in a safe and efficient manner. Although no definitive evidence exists to prescribe an ideal cadence for the eccentric action, a 2-second tempo seems to be enough to ensure the load is lowered under sufficient control to bring about desired results (6, 79).
